'''Fairy Dust''' is a single-use [[Crafting|craftable item]] that allows the player to make a machine immediately finish the process it is carrying out. The player receives the recipe after completing [[Quests#The Pirate's Wife|"The Pirate's Wife"]] quest for [[Birdie]]. 

One to two Fairy Dust can be obtained as a prize from the [[Mayor's Manor#Prize Machine|Prize Machine]]. It can also be found in [[Fishing#Golden Treasure Chests|Golden Fishing Treasure Chests]] (7% chance).<ref name="chestchance" /> Five Fairy Dust is the reward for completing the [[Giant Stump|Raccoon]]'s fourth request, and seven Fairy Dust is a possible reward for the sixth request and beyond. 

The [[Bookseller]] trades 8 Fairy Dust for 1 [[Book Of Stars]]. Once unlocked, the [[Giant Stump#Raccoon Wife's Shop|Raccoon's wife]] near the Giant Stump will trade 1 Fairy Dust for 1 [[Mystic Syrup]].

Fairy Dust does not work on [[Incubator]]s, [[Ostrich Incubator]]s, or [[Slime Incubator]]s. When used in [[cask]]s, the product does not go directly to iridium quality unless it is currently in gold quality. Instead, it will upgrade to the next quality level each time Fairy Dust is used, until iridium quality has been reached.
